sections.name: SendMessageDto
sections.title: Chat message request fields
sections.what: Defines the message body. The text is required and must not be empty. The session id and reference id are optional and must be UUIDs. The context type is optional text. Each field has a documentation description.
sections.why: Likely reason: the message is required, while other fields narrow the search or reuse an existing session.
sections.watch_out: The context type is free text, so any value is accepted and the service treats unknown values as ordinary context.

summary: Defines the shape and checks for a chat message request, so bad input is refused before the chat service runs.
purpose: Describes what a client must send to post a chat message: the text, and optional session id, context type and reference id.
why: Likely reason: checking input at the entrance stops malformed requests early and documents the API for the API page.
how: 1. The message text must be present and not empty. 2. The session id, if given, must be a valid UUID. 3. The context type, if given, must be text. 4. The reference id, if given, must be a valid UUID. The documentation tags describe each field.
inputs: The JSON body of a send message request.
outputs: A checked message object or a rejection with the reason.
risks: The context type accepts any text, so a typo will not be caught and will be stored as is.
debug: A 400 response lists which field failed. Check that session and reference ids are UUIDs.
